title: Evo-Bench: Can Language Models Improve Agent Harness?
title_zh: Evo-Bench：语言模型能否改进智能体 Harness？
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have driven rapid progress in autonomous agents, yet standard evaluations remain confined to static task solving. An emerging frontier is harness evolution---the agent's capacity to autonomously optimize its own operating harness. However, systematically benchmarking this capability remains challenging, as existing evaluations fail to isolate harness improvements from base model strength, prevent task-specific overfitting, or capture long-horizon iterative research. To address these challenges, we introduce Evo-Bench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate models' intrinsic harness-evolving capabilities across Search, Office, and General agent domains. To rigorously isolate this capability, Evo-Bench employs a novel harness-guided construction framework: it leverages auxiliary-task evolution to identify tasks genuinely sensitive to framework improvements, followed by sensitivity-aware stratified splitting to ensure robust cross-suite generalization. Extensive evaluations across nine frontier and open-weight models reveal that top models achieve massive absolute gains reaching 16.6 points, closely approaching state-of-the-art human-engineered baselines. Crucially, while autonomous evolution outpeforms artificial harness in General tasks and excels in Search tasks, it struggles in Office tasks that demand highly specific processing workflows. Furthermore, our analysis exposes critical temporal anomalies like early saturation, while demonstrating that the synthesized harnesses act as highly transferable reasoning structures, consistently boosting diverse policy models.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）推动了自主智能体的快速发展，但现有评测多局限于静态任务求解。本文关注一个新前沿：harness evolution，即智能体自主优化自身运行框架（harness）的能力。为系统评测这一能力，作者提出 Evo-Bench，这是首个面向模型内在 harness 演化能力的基准，覆盖 Search、Office 和 General 三类智能体场景。Evo-Bench 通过 harness-guided construction framework 隔离 harness 改进与基础模型能力的影响：先利用辅助任务演化筛选出真正对框架改进敏感的任务，再通过 sensitivity-aware stratified splitting 保证跨套件泛化。对 9 个前沿与开源权重模型的评测显示，顶级模型可获得最高 16.6 分的绝对提升，接近人类工程设计的 SOTA harness。结果表明，自主演化在 General 任务中优于人工 harness，在 Search 任务中表现突出，但在需要高度特定处理流程的 Office 任务上仍然困难。分析还揭示了早期饱和等时间异常现象，并表明合成 harness 可作为可迁移的推理结构，稳定提升不同 policy models。
key_points_zh: 提出 Evo-Bench，首个专门评测 LLM 智能体自主优化运行 harness 能力的 benchmark，覆盖 Search、Office、General 三类场景。
设计 harness-guided construction framework，通过辅助任务演化与敏感性感知分层划分，尽量隔离基础模型能力与 harness 改进带来的影响。
在 9 个 frontier 与 open-weight models 上评测，顶级模型最高带来 16.6 分绝对增益，接近人类工程设计的 SOTA baselines。
自主演化 harness 在 General 和 Search 任务中效果显著，但在依赖特定流程的 Office 任务上表现较弱。
发现 early saturation 等时间动态异常，并证明合成 harness 具有跨 policy model 的可迁移推理结构价值。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly relevant benchmark for agent harness evolution with careful controls for transferable harness improvement.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项高度相关的智能体框架演化基准，较好地控制并衡量了可迁移的框架改进能力。
